btrfs_uring_encoded_read() is an io_uring version of

column2: which validates the user input and calls

btrfs_encoded_read_regular_fill_pages() through

if it is passed a valid uring_ctx
column2: rather than waking up any waiting

column1: threads it calls btrfs_uring_read_extent_endio(). This in turn copies

complete the io_uring command.

btrfs_uring_read_extent() doesn't clean up after itself if it returns
